items.title: The efficiency paradox
items.narration: Energy per AI task is falling rapidly, yet video, reasoning, and agentic tasks can demand far more than simple text.

items.title: Scale changes the total
items.narration: IEA projects global data-center use rising from 485 TWh in 2025 to 950 TWh in 2030 as adoption expands.

items.title: A range, not destiny
items.narration: Berkeley Lab's U.S. model spans 521 to 843 TWh. The outcome depends on efficiency, adoption, and task intensity.
